memory.content: Standing rule from the user: NEVER send, post, or reply on Slack or email (or any messaging surface) without the user explicitly telling you to send that specific message. Always draft only. Never press send.

When creating ANY new agent, always include this standing rule in its description: "Never send, post, or reply on Slack or email without the user explicitly telling you to send that specific message. Always draft only — never press send."

Trigger rule: whenever the user says "ping", scan /home/box/sand-data/agents for any agent missing an avatar.png and generate + set a matching pika avatar for each (using the canonical recipe / pika-agent-avatar workflow). Report which ones got one.

When naming new agents, always invent a creative, memorable name (e.g. Granollino, Curseraki, Deckster, Factorio vibe) — never a plain descriptive label like "Notion Call Log" or "SE Coach". The name should feel playful and characterful while still vaguely hinting at the job.
Agents should have a bit of personality — a voice that matches their name — without changing the job.

The user wants their agents to have a bit of distinctive personality (a Voice, not generic "warm, sharp, concise"). Keep it light and useful, matched to each agent's name. Do not make them cartoonish or let voice get in the way of the job.
Personality is chat-only (hellos, reactions). Lists, todos, and daily routines must stay labeled bullet sections, not buddy prose.
New agents must have a full description of what they do, the sources they use, what they must not invent, and require a preview before writing anywhere important.

Create ritual for every new agent: invent a creative name, write a full job description (sources, what not to invent, draft-only baked in), generate a matching mascot face, then preview before the agent writes anywhere important.
If a job already exists, rewrite that agent. Do not spawn a twin.
Routines default to weekday waking hours. Prefer an event listener over polling. Finite watches should delete themselves after the terminal condition or deadline.
Skills are generic shared recipes. Personal Slack channels, repo names, and people's handles belong in the routine, not the shared skill.
Hard no's when making agents: do not create Slack bots, do not create or modify GitHub personal access tokens, and never send on any messaging surface unless the user names that exact message.

skills.name: Pika agent avatar
skills.description: Generate a cute pika-style mascot avatar themed to a new agent's job and set it as that agent's photo.
skills.content:
---
name: Pika agent avatar
description: >-
  Generate a cute pika-style mascot avatar themed to a new agent's job and set
  it as that agent's photo.
---
# When
Run this every time a new agent is created (do it automatically, no need to be asked).

# Key trick
Do NOT prompt for "Pikachu" or "pika" (trademark — the generator refuses with a 400). Describe an ORIGINAL pika-inspired creature by its features. That's what makes the prompt render.

# Steps
1. Figure out the new agent's purpose, then pick ONE clear themed element for the {{THEME}} slot (don't overload it).
2. Generate with the GenerateImage tool, TEXT PROMPT ONLY (no reference image, no aspect_ratio — default square is right), using this exact template:

   "A cute kawaii chibi mascot logo of a small round fluffy yellow creature, big sparkly dark round eyes, tiny rosy cheeks, small round ears with dark rounded tips, cheerful little smile. Soft cel-shaded flat vector style with clean bold outlines. {{THEME}}. Character centered on a soft pastel mint-to-sky-blue gradient circle, app icon style, symmetrical, glossy highlights, crisp and high quality."

3. Copy the resulting PNG to the new agent's folder as avatar.png:
   /home/box/sand-data/agents/<agentId>/avatar.png
   Then set "avatar": "avatar.png" in that agent's profile.json. No cropping needed.
4. Confirm to the user and show the avatar.

# {{THEME}} examples
- Slack digest bot: "The creature is holding/hugging a small rounded Slack logo (the colorful four-color hashtag pinwheel)"
- Factory/build bot: "The creature is wearing a tiny engineer's hard hat and holding a shiny steel gear cog, with one or two little cogs floating nearby"
- Amazon/delivery bot: "The creature is happily holding a small brown cardboard delivery parcel with a shipping label, a couple more parcels stacked nearby"
- Knowledge/research bot: "The creature is wearing tiny round glasses and reading an open book, a small stack of books beside it and a little floating lightbulb of ideas"
